policies.projects: Public repositories with owner login TechLuddite (case-insensitive), fork=false. No fork records or fork filter options in a deployed design.
policies.attribution: Account ownership and non-fork status do not establish original authorship or exclusive ownership of code. Credit and license terms remain with the respective authors and projects.
policies.upstream_prs: Include every discovered, individually verified public authored PR to another owner. No per-repository cap. Preserve merged/open/closed-unmerged and draft flags. Search is a frozen bounded discovery, not all historical work.
policies.twitch: Keep Twitch link; gaming-only now; follows appreciated; ongoing charity. No development-streaming, beneficiary or percentage claim. Historical charity acknowledgment is not a current beneficiary claim.
policies.design_only: Frozen inputs; future daily work consumes content/ read-only, changes design only, never refreshes facts or alters content without new operator direction.
policies.approval: Operator-directed content baseline only. Neither design approval nor publication authorization.
